name: shopping-cart-08
title: shopping-cart-08
description: End-edge Drawer cart with free-shipping progress, size selects, and sticky checkout footer.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { MinusIcon, PlusIcon, Trash2Icon, TruckIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/drawer" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import sneakerImg from "./images/sneaker.webp" import watch1Img from "./images/watch-1.webp" import watch2Img from "./images/watch-2.webp" import watch3Img from "./images/watch-3.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const SIZES = ["SM", "MD", "LG", "XL"] as const const FREE_SHIPPING_AT = 150 type Size = (typeof SIZES)[number] type CartItem = { id: number name: string image: string alt: string size: Size price: number quantity: number } const INITIAL_ITEMS: CartItem[] = [ { id: 1, name: "Velvet Sneaker", image: assetSrc(sneakerImg), alt: "Velvet sneaker", size: "SM", price: 20, quantity: 2, }, { id: 2, name: "Smart Watch Timex", image: assetSrc(watch1Img), alt: "Smart Watch Timex", size: "MD", price: 60, quantity: 1, }, { id: 3, name: "French Connection", image: assetSrc(watch2Img), alt: "French Connection", size: "XL", price: 40, quantity: 1, }, { id: 4, name: "Smart Watch", image: assetSrc(watch3Img), alt: "Smart Watch", size: "SM", price: 60, quantity: 1, }, ] export default function ShoppingCart({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false) const [cartItems, setCartItems] = React.useState(INITIAL_ITEMS) const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.quantity, 0) const freeProgress = Math.min(100, (subtotal / FREE_SHIPPING_AT) * 100) const freeRemaining = Math.max(0, FREE_SHIPPING_AT - subtotal) return (
Shopping cart
Review items, quantities, and proceed to checkout.

{freeRemaining === 0 ? "Free shipping unlocked" : `Add $${freeRemaining.toFixed(0)} for free shipping`}

    {cartItems.map((item, index) => (

  • {item.name}

    {item.quantity}

    ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}

    • ))}

Subtotal ${subtotal.toFixed(2)}

Shipping and tax calculated at checkout.

) }
